Thank you for referring this patient for neurological review. I met him today in clinic accompanied by his partner. I have also recommended structured documentation using a calendar or smartphone app to record the timing of warning symptoms, event duration, and recovery features, so that we can quantify numbers during the clustered periods. He will continue levetiracetam at his current dose as he reports tolerability but no perceived benefit so far; we will not change treatment until we have more diagnostic information. I have requested routine bloods (FBC, U&E, LFT, vitamin D) to be done at his GP surgery for baseline monitoring.

For safety, we reinforced standard advice around adequate sleep, regular meals, moderated alcohol intake, and seeking urgent help if any event lasts more than five minutes, occurs back-to-back without recovery, or if he sustains significant injury. He understands not to swim unsupervised, to avoid heights, and to take showers instead of baths.

I will review him in clinic after the ambulatory EEG. Thank you again for the referral and for your ongoing care. Please let me know if there is any additional history or prior imaging that would be helpful to obtain before telemetry.

Lacosamide titration schedule:
- Week 1: 50 mg at night
- Week 2: 50 mg twice daily
- Week 3: 50 mg in the morning and 100 mg at night
- Week 4: 100 mg twice daily (continue at this dose thereafter pending review)
